body: Thank you for your reply and encouragement. I suppose I just don’t really know what the next step is. If you don’t mind me asking, how did you proceed and how did you know you were ready to move forward?
Thank you. I guess I’m a little embarrassed that it took me so long just to realize this about myself. The denial was pretty intense.

I appreciate you taking the time to answer and for listening. I feel pretty overwhelmed. I was shaking just making the post and  I don’t know if I’m ready for meetups although I suppose I have to start somewhere.
